usamo-usamo-1976-01.prompt:
(a) Suppose that each square of a $4\times 7$ chessboard, as shown in the figure, is colored either black or white. Prove that with any such coloring, the board must contain a rectangle (formed by the horizontal and vertical lines of the board such as the one outlined in the figure) whose four distinct unit corner squares are all of the same color.

(b) Exhibit a black-white coloring of a $4\times 6$ board in which the four corner squares of every rectangle, as described above, are not all of the same color.
usamo-usamo-1976-01.answer: (a) Each column has at least $2$ monochromatic (row-pair, colour) combinations, giving $\ge 14 > 6\cdot 2 = 12$, so two columns share one. (b) Use the six different columns with exactly two black squares.

usamo-usamo-1976-02.prompt: If $A$ and $B$ are fixed points on a given circle and $XY$ is a variable diameter of the same circle, determine the locus of the point of intersection of lines $AX$ and $BY$. You may assume that $AB$ is not a diameter.
usamo-usamo-1976-02.answer: The circle through $A$ and $B$ whose center is the intersection $T$ of the tangents at $A$ and $B$ (it is orthogonal to the given circle) — except for the two points of it diametrically opposite $A$ and $B$, which correspond to the excluded positions $X=A$ and $Y=B$.

usamo-usamo-1976-04.prompt: If the sum of the lengths of the six edges of a trirectangular tetrahedron $PABC$ (i.e., $\angle APB=\angle BPC=\angle CPA=90^\circ$) is $S$, determine its maximum volume.

usamo-usamo-1976-05.prompt:
If $P(x)$, $Q(x)$, $R(x)$, and $S(x)$ are all polynomials such that
$$P(x^5) + xQ(x^5) + x^2 R(x^5) = (x^4 + x^3 + x^2 + x +1) S(x),$$
prove that $x-1$ is a factor of $P(x)$.
usamo-usamo-1976-05.answer: Substitute the four primitive fifth roots of unity: $P(1)+\omega Q(1)+\omega^2R(1)=0$ for four distinct $\omega$, so the quadratic $P(1)+Q(1)t+R(1)t^2$ is identically zero; in particular $P(1)=0$.
